# KafkaNoActiveController

<!-- GENERATED by monitoring/dashgen from internal/rules (make alerts). Do not edit. -->

| Severity | Component | Dashboard | for (production / demo) |
|---|---|---|---|
| critical | kafka | [kafka-kraft](http://grafana.localhost:8080/d/kafka-kraft/) | 1m / 15s |

**Summary:** Cluster <kafka_cluster> has no active KRaft controller

No node acts as active controller: metadata is frozen (no leader elections, no topic changes, brokers cannot register). The controller quorum has lost its majority or cannot elect a leader.

## Impact

Metadata is frozen: no leader elections (failed brokers' partitions stay offline), no topic or config changes, brokers cannot register.

## Diagnosis

1. Kafka · KRaft Controller & Quorum → Raft role per node: is any node leader or are they all electing?
2. Controller pod logs: `./kctl -n kafka logs <controller pod> | grep -i -E 'raft|election|quorum'`.
3. A majority of controller voters must be up and able to reach each other.

## Mitigation

- Restore enough controller nodes to regain the majority.
- Check network policies / DNS between controller nodes (port 9090 controller listener in Strimzi).

## Expression

```promql
sum by (kafka_cluster) (kafka_controller_kafkacontroller_activecontrollercount) < 1
```
